chapter: Dave Bartholomew band and early recording
title: Radio remotes from J&M and full-time musician
summary: They did unpaid Sunday radio remotes from the studio behind J&M Music Store; music was his full-time work.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Wow. Was that... Was Cosmos used for... Did you all do a lot of radio... Did you all do radio shows?
Yeah, we do remotes from that studio.
Because it's... The little room that he recorded in was in the rear of J&M Music Store.
It was a music store in the front.
Okay. In the rear, it was the studio.

So we would come in on Sundays and we'd do remotes to... I don't even remember what local radio station it was that we would do the remote for. Mm-hmm. But that's how I found out who Cosmos was and, you know, they just told us where we... We want to do that Sunday. Mm-hmm. And we didn't get paid for it.
It was a promotional thing for something.
Was... During that time, were you... When you were playing with Dave, was music your full-time career? I mean, was that...
Yeah, that's all I did, yeah.
Was that all you did during that time?
